data.title: Poker Hand Analyzer
data.statement:
You must determine the winning poker player (or a tie).

Both players gets 2 cards, and there are 5 community cards (aka board cards).

A poker hand is comprised of the best 5 card hand that can be made out of the players 2 cards, along with the 5 community cards.

Cards are represented by two characters. The first character is the rank of the card (2-9, T, J, Q, K or A) and the second character is the suit of the card (S, D, H, C).
Examples: {{9H}}, {{QC}}, {{AS}}, {{TD}}, {{4C}}

Output "{{PLAYER_1}}" if the first player wins, "{{PLAYER_2}}" if the second player wins, or "{{TIE}}" if both players have an equal strength hand.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You must determine the winning poker player (or a tie).

Both players gets 2 cards, and there are 5 community cards (aka board cards).

A poker hand is comprised of the best 5 card hand that can be made out of the players 2 cards, along with the 5 community cards.

Cards are represented by two characters. The first character is the rank of the card (2-9, T, J, Q, K or A) and the second character is the suit of the card (S, D, H, C).
Examples: 9H, QC, AS, TD, 4C

Output "PLAYER_1" if the first player wins, "PLAYER_2" if the second player wins, or "TIE" if both players have an equal strength hand.
Input
Line 1: Two space separated playing cards for PLAYER_1.
Line 2: Two space separated playing cards for PLAYER_2.
Line 3: 5 space separated playing cards for the community cards.
Output
Line 1: The winning player ("PLAYER_1" or "PLAYER_2") or "TIE"
Constraints
Example
Input
AD 6H
4C JS
2S 5D AH QS TH
Output
PLAYER_1
